title: Projection mate for an augmented coefficient diagram before taking inverse limit
statement:
Let $f:(\mathscr X,R_X)\to(\mathscr Y,R_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi presented by small sites, with a specified ring isomorphism $f^{-1}R_Y\cong R_X$. Module pullback $F=f^*$ is exact and left adjoint to module direct image $G=f_*$. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the ringed-topos convention [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism], and strict inverse sequences indexed by $\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$.
Let $Q_{Y,\bullet}$ be a strict tower of commutative $R_Y$-algebra sheaves with unital algebra transitions, and put $Q_{X,\bullet}=f^*Q_{Y,\bullet}$. Use the reduction functors $B_T$, units $i_T$ and normalized pullback comparison $\tau$ of [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower], and the constant comparison $\chi$ of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-tower-pushforward-normalization]. Write $\mathcal G=Rf_*$ and $\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}=Rf_*^{\rm Tow}$. The ringed projection mate [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] on the diagram sites [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization] for $\Delta_XK$ and $Q_{Y,\bullet}$, with source identified using $\chi_K$, defines a natural strict derived-tower morphism
$$h_K:B_Y(\mathcal GK)\longrightarrow\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}B_X(K).$$
Equivalently, $h_K$ is adjoint to $\tau_{\mathcal GK}$ followed by $B_X$ of the ambient counit $f^*\mathcal GK\to K$. Under the canonical evaluation identifications [lem-weil-pbc-tower-derived-evaluation-normalization], its $n$-th evaluation is the counit-tensor projection map $\mathcal GK\otimes^L Q_{Y,n}\to\mathcal G(K\otimes^L Q_{X,n})$. In the derived category of strict towers one has
$$h_K i_{Y,\mathcal GK}=\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}(i_{X,K})\chi_K.$$
This equality is asserted before evaluation or $R\lim$. No perfectness, invertibility of $h_K$, or completeness is assumed.

proof.text: Put $J=\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$. The rings $R_X,R_Y$ are commutative: the statement tensors over them and calls $Q_{Y,n}$ commutative $R_Y$-algebras, and $R_X\cong f^{-1}R_Y$ inherits commutativity; so the diagram rings $\Delta_TR_T$ are sheaves of commutative rings, as [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization] and [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] require. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization] to both small presenting sites. Its exact module equivalences identify modules over the diagram ring $\Delta_TR_T$ with strict $J$-diagrams of $R_T$-modules; applying the equivalences and their inverses to complexes therefore identifies their derived categories as well. The termwise sheaf adjunction $f^{-1,J}\dashv f_*^J$ is obtained by transposing each component: naturality of the original adjunction says precisely that the transposes commute with each arrow of $J$. Finite limits are levelwise, so $f^{-1,J}$ preserves them. This gives a morphism between the diagram topoi, with ring map $\Delta_YR_Y\to f_*^J\Delta_XR_X$ induced by the specified ring map. Its module pullback and direct image are $F^{\rm Tow},G^{\rm Tow}$. By levelwise exactness [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian] and exactness of $F$, $F^{\rm Tow}$ is exact. Thus the ringed derived adjunction in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact], applied to these diagram sites, is $F^{\rm Tow}\dashv\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}$, with its canonical counit $\varepsilon^{\rm Tow}$.

proof.text:
Write $\mu$ for the canonical derived tensor/pullback comparison on these diagram sites. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] with $E=\Delta_XK$ and $P=Q_{Y,\bullet}$. It gives $\alpha_{\Delta_XK,Q}:\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}(\Delta_XK)\otimes^L Q_{Y,\bullet}\to\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}(\Delta_XK\otimes^L F^{\rm Tow}Q_{Y,\bullet})$. The coefficient pullback is $Q_{X,\bullet}$, so the target is $\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}B_X(K)$ using [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower]. Define
$$h_K=\alpha_{\Delta_XK,Q}\circ(\chi_K\otimes^L1_Q).$$
Its source is $B_Y(\mathcal GK)$ by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-tower-pushforward-normalization]. This is a single morphism in the derived category of strict towers: $\alpha$ has been constructed on the diagram site, rather than assembled from evaluated arrows. It is natural in $K$ because $\alpha$, $\chi$, and tensor are natural. All transitions of $Q$ are part of the diagram object used in this construction.

For $M\in D(R_Y)$ the comparison $\mu_{\Delta_YM,Q}$ identifies with $\tau_M$ of [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower]. Indeed, with flat-term K-flat representatives, both are the ordinary tensor/pullback map $F(x\otimes q)\mapsto F(x)\otimes F(q)$, with the same reduction counits; the uniqueness normalization in that node identifies the derived maps. This is the representative construction of Tag 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product). Transpose the definition of $h_K$ from step 2. The mate formula and naturality of $\mu$ from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] give
$$\begin{aligned}
\varepsilon^{\rm Tow}_{B_XK}F^{\rm Tow}(h_K)
&=(\varepsilon^{\rm Tow}_{\Delta_XK}\otimes1)\mu\,F^{\rm Tow}(\chi_K\otimes1)\\
&=((\varepsilon^{\rm Tow}_{\Delta_XK}F^{\rm Tow}\chi_K)\otimes1)\mu_{\Delta_Y\mathcal GK,Q}\\
&=(\Delta_X\varepsilon_K\otimes1)\tau_{\mathcal GK}
=B_X(\varepsilon_K)\tau_{\mathcal GK}.
\end{aligned}$$
The third equality is the strict counit equation of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-tower-pushforward-normalization]. This proves the asserted equivalent description, with all comparisons in the derived category of strict towers.

source.place: Tags 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product), 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map); explicit transpose calculation with the cited normalizations

proof.text:
The hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-tower-derived-evaluation-normalization] hold: $\operatorname{Mod}(R_T)$ and $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(R_T))$ are Grothendieck abelian by [lem-weil-pbc-small-module-diagrams-grothendieck] (for the second, $J=\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$; for the first, $J$ the one-object category), evaluation is exact [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian], and $F\dashv G$ with $F$ exact by hypothesis. Let $e_n$ denote evaluation and use $\beta_n:e_n\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}\cong\mathcal Ge_n$ from [lem-weil-pbc-tower-derived-evaluation-normalization]. That node carries evaluation of $\varepsilon^{\rm Tow}$ to the specified ambient counit. The evaluations of $B_T$ and $\tau$ are the normalized derived tensors and tensor/pullback comparisons by [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower]. Evaluating the transpose equation of step 3 consequently says that $\beta_{n,B_XK}e_n(h_K)$ is adjoint to
$$F(\mathcal GK\otimes^L Q_{Y,n})\xrightarrow{\mu}F\mathcal GK\otimes^L Q_{X,n}\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_K\otimes1}K\otimes^L Q_{X,n}.$$
By the mate description of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact], this is exactly its counit-tensor projection map, with the source and target claimed in the statement. Uniqueness in the ambient adjunction proves this identification of arrows, not merely of their objects.

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map); evaluation using the specified counit normalization

proof.text:
Compare the transposes of the two maps from $\Delta_Y\mathcal GK$ to $\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}B_XK$. By step 3, the transpose of $h_Ki_{Y,\mathcal GK}$ is
$$B_X(\varepsilon_K)\tau_{\mathcal GK}F^{\rm Tow}(i_{Y,\mathcal GK})
=B_X(\varepsilon_K)i_{X,F\mathcal GK}
=i_{X,K}\Delta_X(\varepsilon_K).$$
Here the first equality is the augmentation equation for $\tau$ in [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower], and the second is naturality of $i_X$: it is tensoring with the fixed algebra unit $\Delta_XR_X\to Q_{X,\bullet}$. On the other hand, naturality of the tower counit gives the transpose of $\mathcal G^{\rm Tow}(i_{X,K})\chi_K$ as
$$i_{X,K}\varepsilon^{\rm Tow}_{\Delta_XK}F^{\rm Tow}(\chi_K)
=i_{X,K}\Delta_X(\varepsilon_K),$$
by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-tower-pushforward-normalization]. The adjunction of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] on the diagram sites is a bijection on Hom sets, so equality of these transposes proves the required strict derived-tower identity. This calculation uses only the algebra units, the cited natural comparisons, and the counits; it imposes no perfectness, completeness, or invertibility condition on $h_K$.

lean.statement: theorem augmentedDiagramProjectionMate (f : RingedPullback R S) [IsIso f.coefficient] [f.V.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits f.L] [PreservesFiniteColimits f.L] (k : Comparison f) (Q : CommMon (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Modules R)) (MY : RingedModel Q.X (MonObj.one (X := Q.X))) (MX : RingedModel (Q.X ⋙ f.L) (pulledUnit f.L (moduleUnit f k) Q.X (MonObj.one (X := Q.X)))) (tau : MY.B ⋙ (termwise f.L).mapDerivedCategory ≅ f.L.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ MX.B) (htau : IsNormalized f.L Q.X (MonObj.one (X := Q.X)) (moduleUnit f k) (flatRepresentatives R) (flatRepresentatives S) MY MX k.mu k.naturality tau) (P : AugmentedProjectionDirectImage f.L f.V f.moduleAdj) : (∀ M : DerivedCategory (Modules S), (termwise f.L).mapDerivedCategory.map ((augmentedDiagramProjection f.L f.V f.moduleAdj P MY.B MX.B tau).app M) ≫ P.dT.counit.app (MX.B.obj M) = tau.hom.app (P.RG.obj M) ≫ MX.B.map (P.d.counit.app M)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (M : DerivedCategory (Modules S)), ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (Modules R)).obj n).mapDerivedCategory.map ((augmentedDiagramProjection f.L f.V f.moduleAdj P MY.B MX.B tau).app M) ≫ (P.beta n).hom.app (MX.B.obj M) = P.d.homEquiv (((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (Modules R)).obj n).mapDerivedCategory.obj (MY.B.obj (P.RG.obj M))) (((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (Modules S)).obj n).mapDerivedCategory.obj (MX.B.obj M)) ((towerDerivedEvaluationInterchange f.L n).inv.app (MY.B.obj (P.RG.obj M)) ≫ ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (Modules S)).obj n).mapDerivedCategory.map (tau.hom.app (P.RG.obj M)) ≫ ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (Modules S)).obj n).mapDerivedCategory.map (MX.B.map (P.d.counit.app M)))) ∧ (∀ M : DerivedCategory (Modules S), MY.i.app (P.RG.obj M) ≫ (augmentedDiagramProjection f.L f.V f.moduleAdj P MY.B MX.B tau).app M = P.chi.hom.app M ≫ P.RT.map (MX.i.app M))
